title: Comics Unleashed With Byron Allen
description: Host and comedian Byron Allen invites four A-List comedians to this round-table comedy talk show. Guest comedians share their own funny perspectives on current events, everyday life, pop culture, entertainment and more. Filmed in front of a live audience in Hollywood, previous guests have included: Dennis Miller, Tom Arnold, Howie Mandel, Jon Lovitz and Cedric the Entertainer.
